title: Parliament Condemns SAPS Commissioner Over Police Infiltration Scandal
detail: South Africa's parliamentary committee issued a damning indictment of SAPS National Commissioner Mkhwanazi over a police infiltration scandal, describing it as a 'serious institutional crisis'. The committee's findings raise urgent questions about the integrity of the national police leadership and the depth of criminal infiltration into law enforcement structures.

media.caption: Parliamentary committee condemns SAPS Commissioner Mkhwanazi over police infiltration scandal
